title: 第一章 血色黄昏第二章 谷底
lines: 南儋洲，清灵域，洛天王朝。
这一夜，月亮是红的。
长孙府的火光映透了半边天，黑烟如柱，直冲云霄。哭喊声、惨叫声、兵刃碰撞声交织在一起，像一曲来自地狱的挽歌。
六岁的长孙岳被管家从密道里推出去的时候，回头看了一眼。
他看见管家的胸口透出一截剑尖。
鲜血顺着剑刃滴落，滴在他脸上，温热的。
“小少爷……走……”
管家用最后的力气推动了机关，密道石门轰然落下。长孙岳听见石门另一侧传来沉闷的撞击声，然后是管家的惨叫——很短，像被什么东西掐断了。
他不记得自己是怎么跑起来的。
密道很窄，只容一人通过。墙壁上每隔十步嵌着一颗夜光石，发出微弱的荧光，勉强照亮前方的路。长孙岳跌跌撞撞地跑着，膝盖磕在石阶上，破了皮，血顺着小腿流进鞋里，他感觉不到疼。
他只记得父亲把他塞进密道时说的话。
“活着。长孙家的血脉，不能断。”
父亲说这话的时候，身上已经中了三刀。白衣被血浸透，像一朵朵盛开的红莲。但他还是笑着的，用那只没受伤的手摸了摸长孙岳的头。
“去找你苏家姐姐。她会护你。”
然后石门关上了。
长孙岳不知道自己跑了多久。密道的尽头是一扇铁门，他推不动，够不着门栓。他急得直哭，眼泪混着脸上的血往下淌。
就在这时，他听见密道里传来了脚步声。
不是他一个人的。
“密道在这里，快追！”
“那老东西死前启动了机关，石门打不开！”
“绕路！从上面走！那小子跑不远！”
长孙岳拼命推那扇铁门，小手拍在冰冷的铁板上，发出沉闷的声响。
门开了。
不是他推开的。铁门是从外面被推开的，月光涌进来，照亮了一张苍老的脸。
“苏……苏爷爷？”
苏家家主苏远山站在门外，身后跟着十几个苏家修士。他看着长孙岳浑身是血的样子，眼眶一下子就红了。
“岳儿，跟我走。”
长孙岳扑进他怀里，浑身发抖。
“苏爷爷，我爹……我爹他……”
“我知道。”苏远山抱紧他，声音发涩，“我都知道了。”
远处传来破风声，追兵将至。
苏远山脸色一变，将长孙岳交给身旁的修士：“带小少爷去坠龙谷方向，从后山绕过去。快！”
“家主，坠龙谷那是——”
“我知道那是什么地方！”苏远山厉声道，“但那里是唯一能挡住他们的地方！快！”随即贴了一张符在长孙岳身上，那是护身符。
长孙岳被人抱起来，往后山的方向跑。他趴在那个修士的肩头，看见苏远山带着其余人迎向追兵的方向。
“苏爷爷！”他喊了一声。
苏远山回头看了他一眼，嘴唇动了动，说了什么。长孙岳没听清，风声太大了。
但他读出了那个口型。
“活着。”
抱着他的修士跑得很快，像一阵风。长孙岳看见两边的树木飞速倒退，天上的红月跟着他一起跑。
追兵的声音渐渐远了，又渐渐近了。
content_en:
Nandanzhou, Qingling Domain, Luotian Dynasty.
This night, the moon is red.
The fire in Changsun Mansion reflected half of the sky, and black smoke shot up into the sky like pillars. Cries, screams, and the clash of weapons intertwined together, like an elegy from hell.
When the six-year-old Zhang Sunyue was pushed out of the secret passage by the housekeeper, he looked back.
He saw the tip of a sword protruding from the butler's chest.
Blood dripped down the blade and onto his face, warm.
"Young Master...let's go..."
The housekeeper used his last strength to push the mechanism, and the stone door of the secret passage fell with a crash. Changsun Yue heard a dull crash from the other side of the stone door, and then the housekeeper's scream - very short, as if it had been cut off by something.
He couldn't remember how he started running.
The secret passage is very narrow, allowing only one person to pass through. There is a luminous stone embedded in the wall every ten steps, which emits weak fluorescence and barely illuminates the road ahead. Changsun Yue stumbled while running, knocking his knee on the stone steps and breaking the skin. Blood flowed down his calf and into his shoes. He felt no pain.
He only remembered what his father said when he stuffed him into the secret passage.
"Live. The bloodline of the Changsun family cannot be broken."
When my father said this, he had been stabbed three times. The white clothes were soaked with blood, like red lotuses in full bloom. But he still smiled and touched Changsun Yue's head with his uninjured hand.
"Go find your sister from the Su family. She will protect you."
Then the stone door closed.
Changsun Yue didn't know how long he had been running. At the end of the secret passage was an iron door, which he couldn't push and couldn't reach the bolt. He was so anxious that he cried, and the tears mixed with the blood on his face and flowed down.
At this moment, he heard footsteps coming from the secret passage.
It's not his alone.
"The secret passage is here, chase it quickly!"
"The old guy activated the mechanism before he died, and the stone door cannot be opened!"
"Detour! Go from above! That kid can't run far!"
Changsun Yue pushed the iron door with all his strength, and slapped his little hand on the cold iron plate, making a dull sound.
The door opened.
He didn't push it away. The iron door was pushed open from the outside, and the moonlight poured in, illuminating an old face.
"Su...Grandpa Su?"
Su Yuanshan, the head of the Su family, stood outside the door, followed by more than a dozen Su family monks. Seeing Changsun Yue covered in blood, his eyes suddenly turned red.
"Yue'er, follow me."
Changsun Yue threw himself into his arms, trembling all over.
"Grandpa Su, my dad...my dad..."
"I know." Su Yuanshan hugged him tightly, his voice was harsh, "I know everything."
There was a sound of breaking wind in the distance, and the pursuers were approaching.
Su Yuanshan's expression changed, and he handed Changsun Yue to the monk beside him: "Take the young master to the direction of Falling Dragon Valley and go around the back mountain. Quick!"
"Master, Falling Dragon Valley is——"
"I know where that place is!" Su Yuanshan said sternly, "But that's the only place that can stop them! Hurry!" Then he put a talisman on Changsun Yue's body. It was an amulet.
Changsun Yue was picked up and ran towards the back mountain. He lay on the monk's shoulder and saw Su Yuanshan leading the others towards the direction of the pursuers.
"Grandpa Su!" he shouted.
Su Yuanshan looked back at him, moved his lips, and said something. Changsun Yue didn't hear clearly because the wind was too loud.
But he read the mouth shape.
"Alive."
The monk holding him ran as fast as a gust of wind. Changsun Yue saw the trees on both sides retreating rapidly, and the red moon in the sky ran with him.
The sounds of the pursuers gradually became distant and then closer.
